summary: Feed s167_triple is degraded: 100% of packets missing required VLANs 10,20, 7.7% TCP packet loss (223/2899), and 94.5% encrypted traffic exceeds NDR 90% tolerance. NDR will have incomplete flows and blind spots without broker fixes.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags - 100% of packets are untagged while NDR requires VLANs 10 and 20. Most likely broker egress policy set to 'strip VLAN' or SPAN trunk not preserving tags.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR loses segmentation context for VLANs 10,20; cannot attribute traffic to correct tenant/zone, breaks detection policies and lateral-movement correlation that rely on VLAN ID.

recommended_fix.why: Restore and forward 802.1Q tags for VLANs 10,20 to the NDR tool port so it can correctly classify and detect across segments.

findings.root_cause: 7.7% TCP gaps (223 of 2899 packets) indicates packet broker buffer/SPAN oversubscription drops under burst, not tool overload (tool_overload healthy). Feed likely exceeds single 10G tool port or SPAN buffer capacity.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR receives incomplete TCP streams, fails to reassemble flows and extract full payload (needs_full_payload=true), causing missed detections, broken session analysis and false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across multiple NDR tool ports / broker egresses with flow-aware hashing to eliminate buffer drops; if SPAN is in use, replace SPAN with passive TAP at the same time to avoid SPAN drop behavior.

findings.root_cause: 94.45% of bytes are encrypted vs NDR tolerance of 90%. Traffic is predominantly TLS/encrypted with no decryption before the tool, leaving NDR with metadata only.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR needs full payload for deep inspection; with 94% encrypted it is effectively blind to payload-based threats (C2, exfiltration, exploit) and limited to JA3/flow metadata.

recommended_fix.why: Decrypt relevant TLS at packet broker (or forward keys/log via key escrow) and re-encrypt to NDR, or selectively bypass trusted encrypted flows, to bring visible payload share within NDR tolerance without violating privacy.
